product.name: LRO WAC Hapke-normalised mosaic (WAC_HAPKE), PDS LRO-L-LROC-5-RDR, LROLRC_2001, DATA/MDR/WAC_HAPKE
product.files: pipeline/wac_sources.json: 8 tiles per band, MD5 from each label, SHA-256 pinned
product.normalisation: I/F normalised to phase = incidence = 60 deg, emission = 0 deg by the Hapke function with the Sato et al. (2014) parameter maps

bands.colour: 415, 643 and 689 nm, as ratios to 566 nm

product.chosen: owner, 2026-09-29: replace Clementine between 70 N and 70 S, and show the measured colour (docs/stories/SS-5b.md)

poles.source: LOLA LDAM polar normal albedo, Lemelin et al. (2016), PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
poles.chosen: owner, 2026-09-25: LOLA near the poles (docs/stories/SS-6b.md); blend band moved to 62-70 deg where the WAC mosaic ends (SS-5b)
poles.conventions: polar stereographic, R = 1737.4 km, 1000 m/px, planetocentric, east-positive, MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421, 1064 nm normal albedo
poles.blend: smoothstep weight from 0 at |latitude| 62 to 1 at 70 deg; LOLA alone poleward, the WAC mosaic alone equatorward
poles.orientation: DSMAP_POLAR.CAT prose (90 E to the right at both poles; south lon 0 up, north lon 0 down); its south-pole inverse formula disagrees and was not used

gapFill.source: LOLA LDAM_10_FLOAT global normal albedo, Lemelin et al. (2016), PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
gapFill.conventions: simple cylindrical, R = 1737.4 km, 10 px/deg (3032 m/px at the equator), planetocentric, east-positive, MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421, 1064 nm normal albedo

localMatch.method: base minus calibrated LOLA, spread into each gap by pull-push

conventions.latitude: planetocentric (the WAC headers say planetographic, identical on a sphere)
conventions.longitude: east-positive; column 0 = -180 deg, last column ends at +180 deg
conventions.bodyFixedFrame: MOON_ME (LRO-era mean Earth/polar axis); see ephemeris.json
conventions.values: 566 nm I/F at i = g = 60 deg, e = 0, stored as byte = 255 sqrt(I/F / 0.25); LOLA mapped onto it by the fits under poles and gapFill

colour.channels: red = I/F(643 nm) / I/F(566 nm), green = I/F(415 nm) / I/F(566 nm), blue = I/F(689 nm) / I/F(566 nm), each byte linear over its range
colour.display: core/moonColour.ts: the reflectance spectrum linear between 415, 566, 643 and 689 nm and flat beyond, lit by a 5772 K blackbody, CIE 1931 to linear sRGB, white-balanced to sunlight
colour.unmeasured: poleward of 70 deg and in the mosaic's gaps: the Moon's median ratios, blended in from 62 to 70 deg

formatChoice.rule: smallest albedo at most 6291456 bytes with PSNR >= 42.0 dB over all pixels and over the WAC region (|lat| < 62) alone

calibration.model: I/F = map I/F at i = g = 60, e = 0, times Hapke(i, e, g; tile) / Hapke(60, 0, 60; tile), tile parameters from public/data/moon/hapke.bin; no scale fitted

consistency.what: per 1-degree tile, 70 N to 70 S: mean map I/F against the I/F the tile's Hapke parameters give at the standard geometry
